purpose: Pre-registered holdout gates for the scaling-ladder extension to 14B / 32B / Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B base evals. Per slm-learning-097 (Two-shot $50 discipline) and slm-learning-103 (Compare-and-Compete), these thresholds are FROZEN before evals fire. After-the-fact threshold relaxation invalidates the row.
knee_definition: Smallest rung that beats 7B by >= 2pp on HE AND MBPP simultaneously. The first rung that clears both axes is the new workhorse-base candidate. Subsequent rungs are evaluated for incremental cost-per-successful-task improvement only.

rungs.decision_if_pass: Promote to workhorse-base candidate. Train kael-14b-* adapters on Kael-house dataset + GAD-tools corpus before deciding 32B fire.
rungs.decision_if_fail_mbpp: 14B HE clears but MBPP fails saturation — strong signal that MBPP is family-saturated at this scale; switch MBPP to MBPP+ (evalplus) for 32B rung.
rungs.decision_if_fail_both: Hold scaling lane; 7B remains workhorse-base; explore Branch-Train-Merge or test-time compute lanes instead.

rungs.decision_if_pass: 32B is workhorse ceiling. Compare cost-per-successful-task vs 14B; train at the smaller passing rung unless cost ratio justifies 32B.
rungs.decision_if_fail_he: 32B HE fails — almost certainly an eval-pipeline bug; investigate before any training.
rungs.decision_if_fail_mbpp: Family-wide MBPP saturation confirmed; flip MBPP+ as canonical and re-run 14B/32B.

rungs.predicted_source: Unmeasured upstream — Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B is hybrid Transformer-Mamba MoE with 3.9B active per token; HE/MBPP not on standard model card.
rungs.knee_pass_criterion: humaneval >= 86.8 AND mbpp >= 84.3 — but the REAL signal here is gad_tools owned-domain delta vs 7B + cost-per-Mtok at 3.9B-active speed
rungs.decision_if_pass: Confirms Qwen3-Next as labeler/comparator candidate per slm-learning-197 (NOT a Kael-backbone candidate per teacher_species_policy). Use for bulk distillation arms only.
rungs.decision_if_fail: Reduces priority of Qwen3-Next as labeler/comparator; keep Qwen2.5-Coder-32B as the open-weight comparator anchor.
rungs.notes: Pre-fire check: confirm transformers>=4.50 in modal_app eval image actually loads Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct. The hybrid Transformer-Mamba MoE architecture may need a newer transformers version; if so, bump the image pin OR add a fallback rung at gpt-oss-20b/120b on the same row.

fire_readiness_pre_check.1_modal_pricing_verified: Required: confirm A100-80GB and H100 Modal pricing matches the cost projections within +/- 20%. Current row: A100 ~$2/hr, H100 ~$3.5-5/hr.
fire_readiness_pre_check.2_h100_route_added: DONE 2026-05-09 — modal_app/eval_adapter.py now has score_h100 entrypoint.
fire_readiness_pre_check.3_h100_capacity_check: Operational — verify Modal H100 availability at fire time; cold queue may delay 80B-A3B run.
fire_readiness_pre_check.4_volume_free_space: Required: data/registry/teachers.json + slm-models volume must have >= 250 GB free for 14B + 32B + 80B-A3B downloads. Per slm-learning-105 hardware policy.
fire_readiness_pre_check.5_transformers_pin_for_80b_a3b: Required: confirm modal_app eval image transformers>=4.50 loads Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B; if not, bump pin or fall back to gpt-oss-20b/120b for the comparator row.
fire_readiness_pre_check.6_owned_domain_eval_corpus: data/processed/gad_tools-eval/* must exist and have >= 50 rows for the gad_tools axis to produce a reliable signal.

post_run_promotion_protocol: After all 3 rungs land: scripts/eval/scaling_ladder_aggregator.py walks 1.5B/3B/7B/14B/32B/80B-A3B rungs and emits a markdown + JSON aggregate. Smallest passing rung becomes the new workhorse-base for Kael training; ladder data updates data/registry/teachers.json + reports/research/teacher_species_policy.md.
abort_protocol: If any rung's compute exceeds the gate budget by 50% (e.g., 14B run goes over $3.00), pause the ladder and re-spec before continuing. No silent budget overruns per slm-learning-097.
